# Town of Bethel municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Bethel official website, Selectboard page: lists Denise Guilmette (Chair), David Eddy, Jordan Garrow, Jed Scott, and Ben Roberts, with term expirations running to 2027, 2028, and 2029.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists four of the five Bethel Selectboard members (Guilmette, Eddy, Garrow, and Benjamin Roberts); it omits Jed Scott, whom the town's own Selectboard page lists as the fifth member.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Pamela Brown as Town Clerk of Bethel and as Town Treasurer of Bethel.

Town of Bethel FY2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table (report p. 52) lists Pamela Brown as Town Clerk and Town Treasurer. The March 3, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (report pp. 4-5) elects the clerk and treasurer for one-year terms; the town publishes no 2026 results.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Pamela Brown as Town Clerk of Bethel and as Town Treasurer of Bethel.
Town of Bethel FY2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table (report p. 52) lists Pamela Brown as Town Clerk and Town Treasurer.
Town of Bethel official website, 'Other Elected Officials' page: lists Dana Cole-Levesque as Moderator.
Town of Bethel FY2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table lists Dana Cole-Levesque as Moderator.

Town of Bethel official website, 'Other Elected Officials' page: lists the Trustees of Public Funds as Eric Benson (term expires 2028), Sandy Farrell (term expires 2026), and Scott Putney (term expires 2026). The FY2025 Town Report prints 'Rick Benson' for the 2028 seat; the current website form is recorded. The Farrell and Putney seats stood for election in March 2026 and the town publishes no results, so only Benson is recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Bethel justices of the peace: Lisa Campbell, Cathy Day, Eleanor Griffin, Caleb Harwood, Mark Heckmann, D Gene Kraus, and Kirk White.
Town of Bethel official website, 'Other Elected Officials' page: lists the same seven justices of the peace (in shortened forms: Gene Kraus, Ele Griffin, Mark Heckman).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Bethel justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
